description: This file defines a Webpack plugin called ReactRefreshWebpackPlugin that integrates React Fast Refresh functionality into Webpack builds, supporting both Webpack 4 and 5. It includes methods for injecting refresh functions and handling module execution interception.

classes.name: ReactRefreshRuntimeModule
classes.description: A custom Webpack RuntimeModule for React Fast Refresh in Webpack 5.

methods.name: injectRefreshFunctions
methods.description: Injects refresh-related functions into the Webpack compilation template hooks.

methods.name: webpack4
methods.description: Configures the plugin for Webpack 4, injecting refresh functions and intercepting module execution.

methods.name: webpack5
methods.description: Configures the plugin for Webpack 5, adding a custom RuntimeModule for refresh and intercepting module execution.
